title: QA wave R2a: checklist run `surface:api` (49 items) at e4e5c6e3
body:
Part of #9296.
Blocked-by: #9298

The cheap, high-fan-out lane: **no console build is needed** for these — boot the framework and drive REST. 26 of the 49 carry an `automated.ref`; run the pin and cite its output rather than re-proving by hand (RUNNER rule 6).

## Contract

- `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs surface:api --json` selects the set. Blocked items stay excluded.
- Execute via the **`checklist-test` skill** + `RUNNER.md` + `dogfood-verification`. Run in the QA tree from #9298.
- API items are cheap enough to fan out widely — **but every concurrent item still gets its own free non-default port and its own `file:/tmp/qa-wave/<item>.db`**. Shared port or shared DB is the `shared-browser-tab` trap wearing a different hat.
- Both sides of every gate: for permission/visibility clauses, prove the entitled persona sees it **and** that the unentitled one is refused **by the server** — a forged direct request where feasible, since UI absence is only a client courtesy (ADR-0057 D10).
- Watch the `dispatcher-vs-hono-route` trap: the oracle is a live server trace, never a simulated dispatch.

## Output

One `qa-run` issue in the RUNNER format (+ `bug` if any clause fails). Text only. Link back here and on #9296.
